tests.title: signup validates, retries without losing input and carries the selected plan through authentication
slow signup cancellation, route departure and synthetic IME cannot create a late session
social cancellation restores focus; a sample identity succeeds and duplicate signup remains editable
local email verification survives StrictMode, supports expiry/cancel/retry and confirms no real email
narrow signup exposes complete fields and buttons with long Korean input and text enlargement
